automaticViews: Same full frame plus at most five frozen PicoDet proposals; merge max cosine by product
manualViews: Frozen old human regions, reported separately; never used in automatic scores

calibration.negatives: Four truly absent queries plus seven known queries with the target SKU removed from the calibration gallery
calibration.threshold: nextafter(maximum of automatic negative top scores, +infinity); freeze before test encoding

test.extraNegatives: For every known test query, remove only its target SKU in memory and measure false candidates; do not mutate the catalog

scope: Offline model comparison only; no application/model switching, API providers, catalog writes, deployment or model training
limits: Known development cases, not a blind independent test
Video gallery/query frames are correlated; current two added views remain in the fixed gallery
Calibration contains artwork and a different gallery/domain; its zero empirical false accepts do not guarantee test precision
Raw top-1/top-5 and accepted results are separate; cosine scores are not SKU probabilities
